description: This file defines a function 'transformProps' that processes chart properties for a table visualization in Apache Superset. It handles data transformation, formatting, comparison calculations, pagination, and styling configurations.

classes.name: DateWithFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for handling date formatting and conversion within data records.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if all values for a given key in data are numeric or null/undefined.

methods.name: processDataRecords
methods.description: Processes data records, converting temporal columns to DateWithFormatter instances for formatting and sorting.

methods.name: calculateDifferences
methods.description: Calculates absolute and percentage differences between two numeric values.

methods.name: processComparisonTotals
methods.description: Aggregates and computes differences for comparison totals across data records.

methods.name: processComparisonDataRecords
methods.description: Transforms data records to include comparison metrics and differences for time-based comparisons.

methods.name: processColumns
methods.description: Generates column metadata including labels, formats, and descriptions based on datasource and form data.

methods.name: getComparisonColConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for comparison columns based on label and parent column key.

methods.name: getComparisonColFormatter
methods.description: Determines the formatter for comparison columns, including currency and number formats.

methods.name: processComparisonColumns
methods.description: Creates additional columns for comparison metrics (main, delta, percent, etc.) based on original columns.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Automatically determines page size based on total number of cells and optional user setting.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main function that transforms chart properties into a format suitable for rendering, including data processing, styling, pagination, and comparison logic.
